title: Toasts
summary: Non-intrusive toast notification component for displaying transient messages with auto-dismiss and queue management.
features: Multiple semantic variants: neutral, success, warning, error with variant-specific icons
Auto-dismiss with progress bar and pause-on-hover
Stackable notifications with optional queue limit
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Toast component delivers lightweight, non-blocking notifications that inform users about application events without interrupting their workflow. Toasts communicate success confirmations, warnings, errors, and neutral information while allowing continued interaction with the underlying interface.

## Use Cases

- Confirm successful operations such as saving data or completing purchases
- Display warning messages about potential issues requiring attention
- Show error notifications when operations fail with optional retry actions
- Provide neutral informational messages about system status or updates
- Queue multiple simultaneous notifications with configurable display limits

## Design Rationale

Toasts use a global state store pattern for centralized queue management, enabling programmatic triggering from anywhere in the application. The progress bar and pause-on-hover features give users control over dismissal timing. Semantic variants with distinct icons ensure quick visual recognition of message importance, while ARIA roles and keyboard navigation maintain accessibility standards.
shortDescription: Delivers lightweight, non-blocking notifications about application events. Uses global state store pattern with createGlobalState for centralized queue management, enabling programmatic triggering from anywhere. Supports rich content through HTML or component slots. Includes ARIA roles (status/alert), aria-live regions, and keyboard navigation for accessibility. Transition animations match positioning direction with smooth 200-300ms timing.
